title: Continuous ringed-topos module direct image
statement: For small sites (C,J) and (D,K), a continuous functor F:D to C, a left-exact left adjoint L to set-sheaf direct image, commutative ring sheaves R on J and S on K, and a ring-sheaf map S to F_*R, there exists a ringed-topos morphism from (J,R) to (K,S) [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] whose module direct-image functor [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] equals the ordinary continuous-site module pushforward along the underlying ring map.

proof.text: Use the adjunct of the structural ring map and the ordinary module pushforward. Pair direct-image sections sectionwise. Adjunction naturality and the product projections identify its transpose with the pair of transposes; terminal uniqueness treats constants. Transpose the equations for zero, one, addition, multiplication and scalar action to establish every ringed-topos field. The module functor is the chosen pushforward by construction. The same formulas work for zero rings and empty sites.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousRingedToposModuleDirectImage_exists
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (F : D ⥤ C) [F.IsContinuous K J]
    (L : Sheaf K (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u))
    (adj : L ⊣ F.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u) K J)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (S : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
    (φ : S ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u} K J).obj R) :
    ∃ p : RingedToposMorphism
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)
      ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj S),
      p.modules = SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (F := F) (J := K) (K := J)
        ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map φ)
